lure: A 69.90 euro debit for a subscription you never took
ask: Contest the debit on a page that asks for your online banking codes

message.subject: Avis de prélèvement de 69,90 €
message.body: Madame, un prélèvement de 69,90 € sera effectué sur votre compte [bank account number] pour votre abonnement Classplus Pro. Vous disposez de 7 jours ouvrés pour le contester : [Contester ce prélèvement](https://contestation-prelevement.test/fr)

source.attribution: Prudence demo cases (Scam Shield), CC BY 4.0

verdict.headline: This is not Bouygues Telecom, and the account number proves nothing.
reasons: The link goes to a copied bank page, not to the bank.
The account number quoted leaked in a data breach; a scammer can know it.
